column1: # Danish glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Danish, forms separated by " | ". Danish has no ending-matching in check.py, so every definite and genitive form and every compound a lock word needs is listed. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.
# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows (and renamed ids) wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/da.tsv until then.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting by the measured word.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first.
